test.create_query: CREATE TABLE text_index_prewhere_order ( service LowCardinality(String), host LowCardinality(String), ts DateTime, message String, INDEX idx_message message TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (service, toUnixTimestamp(ts))
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO text_index_prewhere_order SELECT concat('service_', toString(number % 20)), concat('host_', toString(number % 20), '_', toString(intHash32(number) % 10)), toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00') + intDiv(number, 20), concat( ['INFO', 'INFO', 'INFO', 'WARN', 'ERROR'][1 + intHash64(number) % 5], ' ', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> ['alpha', 'bravo', 'charlie', 'delta', 'echo', 'foxtrot', 'golf', 'hotel', 'india', 'juliett', 'kilo', 'lima', 'mike', 'november', 'oscar', 'papa'][1 + cityHash64(number, i) % 16], range(4)), ' ')) FROM numbers_mt(20000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM text_index_prewhere_order PREWHERE host = 'host_7_3' WHERE hasAnyTokens(message, ['alpha', 'bravo', 'charlie', 'delta', 'echo', 'foxtrot'])
SELECT ts, host, message FROM text_index_prewhere_order WHERE hasAnyTokens(message, ['alpha', 'bravo', 'charlie', 'delta', 'echo', 'foxtrot']) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100
